design_system.name: FurnitureOS - Industrial Utility
design_system.description: A minimalist, utilitarian design system for furniture production management. Combines the precision of architectural blueprints with the tactile warmth of a craftsman's workshop.

typography.instructions: Import fonts from Google Fonts in index.css. Use Manrope for all headings to give a modern, geometric feel. Use Public Sans for body text for high legibility in dense tables. Use JetBrains Mono for ALL financial data, dimensions, and IDs.

layout.grid_system: Grid Mode B (High Density). Use grid-cols-12 for dashboards. Sidebar is fixed width (250px).

buttons.default: h-9 px-4 py-2 rounded-sm font-medium transition-all active:scale-95
buttons.secondary: bg-white border border-input hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground shadow-sm

cards.style: bg-white rounded-sm border border-border shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-200

inputs.style: h-9 rounded-sm border-input bg-transparent px-3 py-1 text-sm shadow-sm transition-colors file:border-0 file:bg-transparent file:text-sm file:font-medium placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50

badges.style: inline-flex items-center rounded-full border px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold transition-colors focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-ring focus:ring-offset-2

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-md bg-white/80 border-white/20 (Use sparingly for sticky headers)
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise texture on the sidebar background to give it a 'cast iron' feel.

motion.instructions: Use micro-interactions for all clickable elements. Lists should stagger in.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text is at least 4.5:1 against background. Use APCA standards.
accessibility.focus: Visible focus rings on all interactive elements.

instructions_to_main_agent: 2. FONTS: Add Manrope, Public Sans, and JetBrains Mono to index.css via @import.
3. LAYOUT: Create a Layout component with a fixed dark sidebar and a scrollable light main area.
4. COMPONENTS: Use the provided Shadcn components in /src/components/ui. Customize them to match the 'rounded-sm' and 'border-gray-200' aesthetic.
5. PAGES: Implement 'Orders List', 'Order Detail', 'Production Calendar', and 'Materials Database'.
6. COST CALCULATOR: Use a grid layout for the calculator. Use JetBrains Mono for all input fields involving numbers.
7. CALENDAR: Use a library like 'react-big-calendar' or build a custom grid using CSS Grid for the Gantt chart. Ensure drag-and-drop feels solid.
8. TESTING: Add data-testid to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, rows).
universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for backgrounds, use solid colors or subtle textures.
Avoid 'AI slop' - no generic centered layouts.
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical designs.
